notes: x,y are the callout locations returned by valorant-api; z is the measured floor height under the callout where the mesh stage found one (see each zone's positionProvenance).

provenance.graph: measured-on-mesh for kind walk/drop; manual-approx for special edges and approx-links (see each edge)
provenance.plantZones: derived-by-rule (callout-centred square; not the real plant boundary)
provenance.sightlines: measured-on-mesh visibility fraction; type and smokeable derived-by-rule
provenance.soundLinks: derived-by-rule (one link per travel connection; attenuation by distance bucket / door)
notes: Art geometry only (no collision layer in the source scene): walkability and occlusion are inferred from visible meshes.
Grid distances overestimate straight walks by up to ~8 % (8-neighbour metric).

movement.note: Same model as Ascent: run 6.75 m/s documented base speed, walk ~3.4 m/s approximate (manual-approx).

routes.note: edge.route.waypoints run from edge.from to edge.to in game uu and include both zone anchors. A bidirectional edge is walked back along the reversed waypoints unless edge.routeReverse exists. Edge length/time are the route's; the earlier values are under edge.beforeRoute.

mechanics.name: Two one-way teleporters (A Short -> B Short, B Long -> A Lobby)
mechanics.how: two one-way roadmap links between measured points (traversals in this file), each with its own travel time; the zone graph carries one edge kind=teleporter per link, no sound link (the map-wide teleporter audio cue is NOT modelled; the exit doors are listed in bind.objects.json but not simulated)
mechanics.provenance: measured-on-mesh (entry frames, arrival rooms); manual-approx (which entry leads where, travel time: general game knowledge)
